memory_update.text: POWL should remain in the data-center power BOP universe as a direct medium-voltage switchgear and packaged electrical systems candidate; key survival test is verified data-center backlog share and repeatability.

nVent was not included in the four-candidate list due to limit constraints but deserves a follow-up pass as a large-cap but unusually direct liquid-cooling, enclosures and power-distribution candidate.

For AI data centers, the likely chokepoint set extends beyond generators and grid interconnection into medium-voltage switchgear, busway, electrical raceway/cable management, chillers, liquid-cooling CDUs, pumps, valves, sensors, commissioning and field services.

node: Data-center power and thermal balance of plant
summary: Expanded the direct public-company universe for AI data-center power and thermal balance-of-plant. The highest-confidence direct exposures found in this pass are Vertiv as the obvious reference leader, Powell Industries in medium-voltage switchgear and packaged electrical systems, Modine in data-center cooling and chillers, and Atkore in electrical raceway/cable-management infrastructure. The main underfollowed lane remains smaller industrial suppliers whose data-center exposure is visible in orders, capacity expansion, or product positioning but is not always categorized as AI infrastructure.
